# Shape: byte for byte 0751-isolation-run-multi-block/'s a0 before-dump, kept
# under that file's own name so its <value> still says 0xA0 -- the whole of
# what DUMP_VALUE reads out of a dump name. `ecrw.py dump 0x0750 0x0010` as
# §3's step 0 takes it -- a short range around 0x0751 rather than the whole
# 0x0700 page the procedure dumps, because §4.6 is the only question these
# files are read for and 0x0751 is the only address it is about. 0x0751 reads
# 0x10 here, the mode block 1 starts in. Copied rather than shared so an edit
# to that day's dumps cannot move this set's block under it.
0750: 00 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
